scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from standard Newton identities, character orthogonality and elementary symmetric polynomial facts. The bundled verifier supplies reproducibility checks but finite tests are not a universal proof. Authors and independent certification are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The optimal coefficient concerns exactly four independent draws and quartic finite-field moment-curve extension in characteristic greater than four; no higher-degree, Euclidean, small-characteristic, or phase-stability claim is made. Only same-model review has been performed, not independent mathematical validation. An older equivalent majorization inequality remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Sharp global quadratic stability for quartic moment-curve Fourier extension
